prompts.wolf: Use case: stylized-concept. RPG sprite atlas, realistic detailed Chinese fantasy 3D render. Subject: silver wolf with jade dorsal ridges, gold eyes, matching reference. Landscape1536x1024 transparent background, no scenery, no text or lines. STRICT 8 columns x4 rows =32 complete separate figures. Cell192x256, generous transparent padding at least12px all sides, full figure contained including tail and branches. Fixed elevated orthographic game camera. Columns directions: south/front, southeast/front-right, east/right profile, northeast/back-right, north/back, northwest/back-left, west/left profile, southwest/front-left. Repeat same 8 directions across ALL four rows. Rows consecutive walk cycle phases: left limbs forward, passing, right limbs forward, passing opposite. For floating spirit, four subtle curling leaf poses. Consistent identity scale and center across all frames. Ground feet at 90% cell height; top at20%. Natural limbs articulation, no duplicated legs, clean crisp alpha silhouette, no fog backdrop or ground shadows. Reference if provided specifies identity.
